Public universities in Bangladesh remain a first choice for thousands of students because they combine respected degrees, competitive admission and heavily subsidised education.

For students, the bigger question is not simply how many universities exist. It is which one offers the right subject, location, admission route and cost.

BUET may be the obvious target for engineering. Dhaka University suits a much broader range of subjects. Agriculture, textiles and veterinary science lead to a completely different shortlist.

How Many Public Universities Are in Bangladesh?

The number of public universities in Bangladesh currently cited in recent 2026 reporting is 59 under University Grants Commission oversight.

So why might you see another number?

The UGC also maintains different systems for different purposes. A development-project database, for example, is not automatically a legal census of every university.

Here’s the thing: established, UGC-overseen, funded and actively admitting are not always identical categories.

That is especially important with newer public universities. Before applying, verify the institution through the University Grants Commission of Bangladesh and then check the university's own current admission notice.

Current Public University List in Bangladesh

The public university landscape is easier to understand when universities are grouped by academic type.

The names below use current naming where possible. Several institutions were renamed during 2025, including Netrokona University, Kishoreganj University, Gazipur Agricultural University, Gopalganj Science and Technology University, Pirojpur Science and Technology University and Maritime University Bangladesh. Current university names matter because older articles and search results can still display former names.

The list also includes newer institutions whose level of academic operation may differ. That is why applicants should treat the UGC and individual university websites as the final admission authority.

Top 10 Public Universities in Bangladesh 2026-27

The ranking below is an editorial student comparison based on academic reputation, subject strength, research visibility, admission competition, current international ranking evidence and graduate recognition.

1. University of Dhaka

The University of Dhaka remains one of the strongest all-round public universities in Bangladesh. It works particularly well for students considering law, business, economics, English, sciences and social sciences.

Its central Dhaka location brings another advantage. Students sit close to internships, academic events, professional organisations, competitions and public-sector opportunities.

Best for: Law, BBA, Economics, English, Sciences and Social Sciences

Location: Dhaka

Current ranking signal: #=600 in the QS World University Rankings 2027, according to the current QS profile for the University of Dhaka.

For a student who wants broad subject choice rather than a specialist technical degree, DU remains difficult to overlook.

2. Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

BUET is the strongest specialist choice for many engineering applicants in Bangladesh.

CSE, EEE, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Architecture are among its most sought-after areas. Admission is extremely competitive, and getting into BUET is not the same as getting your preferred department.

Best for: CSE, EEE, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Architecture

Location: Dhaka

Current ranking signal: #711-720 in the QS World University Rankings 2027. The current BUET QS profile also reports an annual undergraduate intake of roughly 1,050 students.

That limited intake helps explain why department allocation becomes so competitive.

3. University of Rajshahi

The University of Rajshahi gives students one of the broadest academic selections outside Dhaka.

Its subject range covers law, science, business, social sciences, arts and several applied areas. RU can therefore work well for students who want a traditional general university without the living costs and congestion of central Dhaka.

Best for: Law, Science, Business, Arts and Social Sciences

Location: Rajshahi

A practical advantage is the city itself. Accommodation and daily expenses can be easier to manage than in Dhaka, although a student's actual budget still depends heavily on housing.

4. Jahangirnagar University

Jahangirnagar University combines broad academic choice with a large residential environment near Dhaka.

Its strengths extend across biological sciences, mathematics, social sciences, business, arts and law. That mix appeals to students who want a traditional university campus while staying within reach of the capital.

Best for: Biological Sciences, Economics, Social Sciences, Business, Mathematics and Law

Location: Savar, Dhaka

For students who dislike the density of a central city campus, JU offers a noticeably different experience.

5. University of Chittagong

The University of Chittagong is one of the country's major general public universities and covers a wide range of subjects.

Students can find established programmes in business, law, sciences, social sciences, arts and related disciplines.

Best for: Business, Law, Sciences, Arts and Social Sciences

Location: Chattogram

The campus sits outside the main city centre, so transport and accommodation deserve attention before admission. For students from south-eastern Bangladesh, however, CU can provide a strong university option without moving to Dhaka.

6. Shahjalal University of Science and Technology

SUST is especially attractive to students interested in computing, science and technology-focused education.

Its academic portfolio includes CSE, EEE, engineering-related subjects, natural sciences, life sciences, business and social sciences. That makes it broader than a narrowly specialised engineering university.

Best for: CSE, Applied Sciences, Engineering-related Subjects and Natural Sciences

Location: Sylhet

The current QS profile for SUST lists CSE, EEE, Civil and Environmental Engineering and several science programmes among its undergraduate options.

For technology-focused students, SUST deserves comparison with the major engineering universities rather than being judged only by a broad national ranking.

7. Bangladesh Agricultural University

Bangladesh Agricultural University should be judged as a specialist institution.

Its strongest areas include agriculture, veterinary science, fisheries, animal husbandry and agricultural economics. If a student already knows that agriculture or animal sciences will shape their career, BAU can be a better choice than a general university ranked above it.

Best for: Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Agricultural Economics

Location: Mymensingh

This is a good example of why subject strength sometimes matters more than an overall top-10 position.

8. Khulna University

Khulna University offers a comparatively focused academic environment with strengths in science, life sciences, business, social sciences and interdisciplinary study.

Students who prefer a university outside Dhaka may find the setting attractive, particularly when they want to balance academic reputation with a quieter city environment.

Best for: Life Sciences, Science, Business and Interdisciplinary Study

Location: Khulna

KU may receive less public attention than DU or BUET, but that does not make it a weak choice. For the right department, it can provide a sensible mix of academic quality, location and cost.

9. Bangladesh University of Professionals

BUP differs from many traditional public universities because of its structured and professionally oriented environment.

It is particularly relevant for students considering business, international relations, development studies and other professional programmes. Its Dhaka location also places students close to employers and professional networks.

Best for: Business, International Relations, Development Studies and Professional Education

Location: Dhaka

One practical point matters here. Programme fees can differ from those at traditional public universities, so applicants should check the current official fee schedule instead of assuming that every public university has the same cost.

10. Bangladesh University of Textiles

BUTEX is one of the clearest examples of why specialist reputation matters.

The university focuses on textile engineering and related areas connected directly with Bangladesh's textile and apparel industries. A student committed to this sector may reasonably place BUTEX above several larger general universities.

Best for: Textile Engineering, Fabric Technology, Apparel Engineering and Textile-related Fields

Location: Dhaka

For students who already know they want a career linked to textiles, garments or apparel production, BUTEX offers a much more targeted academic route.

How This Public University Ranking Was Built

No single metric gives a sensible answer for every student.

The ranking gives the greatest weight to academic and research strength, followed by subject reputation and current external ranking signals. Admission competitiveness, national recognition and practical value also matter.

This is an editorial framework, not an official UGC ranking system.

Here’s the mildly surprising part: DU currently sits above BUET in the overall QS World University Rankings, but that does not make DU the automatic first choice for an engineering applicant.

A broad university ranking and a subject decision answer different questions.

Public University Seats and Admission 2026-27

Public university admission rules vary by institution and academic year.

The basic path is familiar. Students check eligibility, submit an online application, sit the relevant admission test, follow the merit or waiting list and then complete subject allocation and final admission.

The tricky part often comes after the result.

A student may earn a place at a university and still miss CSE, EEE, law or BBA because subject allocation depends on merit position and available seats.

BUET is a useful example. Its current QS information reports an undergraduate intake of roughly 1,050 students a year.

That total is spread across multiple highly competitive departments. Simply qualifying therefore does not guarantee a student's preferred engineering subject.

Always use the individual university's current admission portal for eligibility, seat numbers, application fees, dates, subject allocation and migration rules.

Tuition Fees and Student Living Costs

Public universities receive substantial government support, so tuition is generally much lower than at most private universities.

That does not mean university life is free.

A single national fee figure would be misleading because academic charges vary by university and programme. A real current example is more useful.

QS currently lists domestic tuition at SUST as starting from about US$90 and estimates typical student living costs in Sylhet at roughly BDT 8,000 to BDT 10,000 per month, depending on accommodation and lifestyle.

Treat those figures as a planning reference, not as a fixed bill for every student.

The real calculation is:

academic fees + accommodation + food + transport + books + personal expenses

A student with a subsidised hall seat may spend much less than someone renting privately in Dhaka.

Families keeping an overseas postgraduate degree as a later option can also explore ways to prepare financially for international education, but that should remain separate from the immediate public university admission budget.

Scholarships, Stipends and Financial Support

Public university students may qualify for university stipends, merit awards, need-based support or government assistance.

There is also a useful current figure for financially disadvantaged students.

Under the 2026 guidelines, the Prime Minister's Education Assistance Trust states that eligible students at undergraduate or equivalent level can receive BDT 8,000 in admission assistance through its official e-admission assistance system.

The same official system explains that applicants need supporting documents, including identity records, financial-status certification and a recommendation from the educational institution.

Students should check the latest notice rather than relying on an old screenshot or social-media post.

Those planning beyond local financial support can compare broader scholarship opportunities. If international postgraduate study is part of the long-term plan, this guide to preparing for study abroad from Bangladesh can help with that separate decision.

How to Choose the Right Public University

Start with your subject, not the logo.

If you want engineering, build your shortlist around BUET, CUET, KUET, RUET and DUET. For law or business, DU, RU, JU, JnU and BUP become more relevant. Agriculture leads towards BAU and specialist agricultural universities.

Then look at merit requirements, department allocation, city, accommodation and total cost.

Suppose one student receives a lower-demand department at a famous university while another gets exactly the subject they want at a slightly lower-ranked campus. The second student may actually have the stronger long-term choice.

That is the part league tables often miss.

Specialisation can matter more than overall rank.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many public universities are in Bangladesh?

Recent July 2026 reporting states that the University Grants Commission currently oversees 59 public universities. Different databases may display another figure because legal establishment, development status and active admission are not always counted in exactly the same way.

What is the number of public universities in Bangladesh in 2026?

The current UGC oversight figure reported in July 2026 is 59 public universities. Applicants should still verify the latest status through the UGC because the public university landscape continues to change.

What is the UGC public university list in Bangladesh?

The UGC public university list covers public universities under University Grants Commission oversight. It is the most important regulatory reference when checking whether an institution is officially recognised as a public university.

What are the top 10 public universities in Bangladesh?

A practical top 10 includes the University of Dhaka, BUET, University of Rajshahi, Jahangirnagar University, University of Chittagong, SUST, Bangladesh Agricultural University, Khulna University, BUP and BUTEX.

What are the top 20 public universities in Bangladesh?

The top 20 expands the group to include KUET, CUET, RUET, Jagannath University, JUST, NSTU, Gazipur Agricultural University, Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University, CVASU and PUST.

Which is the best public university in Bangladesh?

For broad general education, the University of Dhaka is one of the strongest choices. For engineering, BUET is usually the first choice. Agriculture, textiles, veterinary science and other specialist subjects have different leaders.

What is the public university ranking in Bangladesh for 2026-27?

Bangladesh does not have one official government league table covering every public university. A useful ranking should consider academic strength, research, subject quality, admission demand, external ranking signals and graduate recognition.

Which public university is best for CSE in Bangladesh?

BUET is usually the strongest first choice for CSE. SUST, DU, CUET, KUET and RUET are also strong options depending on merit position, location and personal preference.

Which public university is best for engineering?

BUET is the leading specialist engineering choice for many students. CUET, KUET, RUET and DUET are also established public engineering universities.

Which public universities are in Dhaka?

Major options include the University of Dhaka, BUET, Jagannath University, BUP, BUTEX, Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University, Bangladesh Medical University, Islamic Arabic University and Dhaka Central University.

Is National University a public university?

Yes. National University Bangladesh is a public university. Its structure is different from a traditional campus university because it operates through a very large network of affiliated colleges.

Is MIST a public university?

MIST is a government engineering and technical institution. Because its institutional structure differs from a conventional UGC public university, it is safer to identify it separately when comparing national public university counts.

Is IUT a public university in Bangladesh?

Not in the same sense as DU or BUET. IUT is an international technical university associated with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, so it should not simply be counted as a regular Bangladeshi public university.

Are public universities in Bangladesh free?

No. They are heavily subsidised rather than completely free. Students still need to budget for academic fees, accommodation, food, transport, books and personal expenses.

Final Advice

Public universities in Bangladesh offer strong academic opportunities at a comparatively affordable cost, but rank alone should never make the final decision.

Choose your subject first. Then compare the universities that teach it well, the merit position you are likely to need, the city you can afford and the career direction you actually want.

For one student, that points to DU. For another, BUET, BAU, SUST or BUTEX will make far more sense.

The best choice is where the university's strengths and your own academic direction actually meet.
